open_questions.question: Is SOC 2 Type II audit required before June 30, 2026 launch, or is Type I compliance at launch with Type II post-launch acceptable?
open_questions.impact_if_unanswered: If Type II audit is pre-launch, Phase 3 requires 4-8 weeks of audit preparation and evidence collection, pushing launch past deadline. If post-launch, Phase 3 focuses on functional testing. Staffing and schedule depend on this clarification.

open_questions.question: Has e-signature service vendor (DocuSign, Adobe Sign, or equivalent) been selected and contracted? If not, who owns vendor selection in Phase 1?
open_questions.impact_if_unanswered: If vendor is not selected by Phase 1 week 2, procurement will consume 2-3 weeks, compressing Phase 2 development window and delaying UC2 (Submit Required Documents) implementation.

open_questions.question: Who is the dedicated Product Owner responsible for backlog prioritization, sprint planning, and stakeholder feedback during Phase 2-3 sprints? Is PO allocated ≥50% to this project?
open_questions.impact_if_unanswered: Hybrid SDLC requires a dedicated PO. Without clear PO assignment and allocation, sprint planning will stall and stakeholder feedback loops will be delayed, compressing Phase 3 testing.

open_questions.question: What is the definition of 'IT account setup automated'? Does this include email only, or email + Slack + SaaS tools (which ones)?
open_questions.impact_if_unanswered: Scope of IT account provisioning affects Phase 2 integration complexity (T15 effort estimate). Unclear scope may result in feature creep or incomplete automation at launch.

open_questions.question: Is Workday API sandbox environment, documentation, and SLA confirmed available? Does integration require custom Workday development or extended vendor support?
open_questions.impact_if_unanswered: If Workday API is unavailable, undocumented, or requires custom development, Phase 2 integration work (T13, T15) will slip 2-4 weeks, compressing Phase 3 testing and risking June 30 deadline.

pm_confidence_score.interpretation: PM confidence score is 62.0 because project has 5 documented assumptions (A1-A5) with 2 CRITICAL risks (R1, R2) and 4 HIGH risks (R3-R6) related to external dependencies (Workday API, SOC 2 scope, e-signature vendor, Product Owner assignment), plus 3 UNKNOWN hard constraints (PO assignment, e-signature vendor status, SOC 2 audit timeline). Hybrid SDLC with fixed June 30 deadline and $80,000 budget amplifies risk of scope creep and schedule slip if assumptions are invalidated. High input quality and clear project understanding provide baseline confidence, but external dependency risks and assumption count (5) cap score at 60 per hard cap rule; actual deductions total 100 points from baseline 100, yielding 62 after cap application.

project_viability.gap_description: Critical path duration (130 days / 26 weeks) is 115% of deadline (June 30, 2026 = 26 weeks from Jan 10, 2026 start). Project is within 1.3x deadline threshold (AT_RISK) but not within 1.0x (VIABLE). If any critical path task slips >2 days, launch deadline is at risk.

scoping_options.title: Defer Nice-to-Have Features to Post-Launch
scoping_options.description: Remove chat with HR bot, mobile app, and LMS integration from MVP scope. Reduces Phase 2 development by ~40 hours (estimated 2 weeks). Moves launch to June 16, 2026 (2 weeks early buffer). Requires stakeholder sign-off on post-launch roadmap.
scoping_options.budget_impact: Reduces estimated cost by ~$5,000 (40h × $125/h avg rate). Stays within $80,000 budget.

scoping_options.title: Compress Phase 1 Requirements Clarification
scoping_options.description: Accelerate resolution of open questions Q1-Q6 to Phase 1 week 1 (vs. week 2). Reduces Phase 1 duration from 3.5 weeks to 3 weeks. Moves Phase 2 kickoff 1 week earlier, providing 1-week buffer for Phase 2-3 slippage. Requires stakeholder availability for rapid decision-making.
scoping_options.budget_impact: No budget impact. Improves schedule buffer.

scoping_options.title: Add Part-Time QA Support in Phase 2
scoping_options.description: Allocate 0.5 FTE QA Engineer (25 hours) in Phase 2 to begin integration testing in parallel with development (vs. Phase 3 only). Reduces Phase 3 testing duration by 1 week. Requires hiring or contracting additional QA resource. Increases budget by ~$3,125 (25h × $125/h).
scoping_options.budget_impact: Increases estimated cost by ~$3,125. Total budget = $83,125 (exceeds $80,000 by $3,125). Requires budget increase or cost reduction elsewhere.
